# Ready-made themes

Import one of these from the homepage: **Customize**, then **Share**, then import the file (or paste its text), check the preview and tap Apply.

| File | Look |
|---|---|
| `k-board.json` | Pink Bubblegum palette on the Scrapbook skin, with a "K's Favorites" group on top |
| `k-night-board.json` | Unicorn Dusk palette on the Control Panel skin, same group |

The group holds games by id (`nightlite-choir`, `sprunki-v2`, `memory-match`, `byte-runner-quest`, `war`). Change the list in the Groups tab, or edit the JSON. All ids are in [../CUSTOMIZE_IDS.md](../CUSTOMIZE_IDS.md). More about the format: [../CUSTOMIZE.md](../CUSTOMIZE.md).
